description: This file is a PHP class definition for 'BankTransfer', a controller extension for payment processing in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles display and confirmation actions related to bank transfer payments.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for the bank transfer payment method extension in OpenCart. It handles displaying payment instructions and confirming transactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the bank transfer payment instructions page with relevant bank details and language specifics.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation process for a bank transfer payment, updating order history and returning a JSON response with success or error information.
